what: When committing/pushing aide-memory-web changes, must cd into aide-memory-web/ first — it's a separate git repo (origin: aide-memory/aide-memory-web on GitHub). Parent repo git commands won't see its changes. After pushing, cd back to /Users/meky/code/aide-v0 for main repo work.
why: Discovered during this session when git add from parent repo silently ignored aide-memory-web/theme.config.jsx. The nested .git means all git operations must happen from within that directory.
